title: Digital wellbeing market in 2025
description:
Hi everyone - not sure if it’s the right channel to post it, apologies if it’s not. We at Consciously Digital Institute conduct annual research of the digital wellbeing market - asking people who work in this field about their products, earnings etc. The idea is to map the digital wellbeing landscape and to show where opportunities are (versus noise). We are finalizing the survey for 2025, which will be open until the end of November.
If you worked full-time or part-time in digital wellbeing in 2025, or know someone who did - please take it. You will be able to instantly see the aggregated results, and in December I will share the key findings in a detailed report. Please, help us make digital wellbeing market more professional - and you can also win one of the two Amazon vouchers $30 each! https://consciously-digital.typeform.com/dw-market2025
